definitions.gloss: tax not included; before tax; pre-tax
definitions.explanation: Indicates that a displayed price does not include consumption tax. Often appears on menus, signs, and packaging, especially after tax-display rules changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{税別|ぜいべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Menu prices are shown without tax.

examples.japanese: {税別|ぜいべつ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{安|やす}く→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{会計|かいけい}→会計：02536_kaikei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{高|たか}く→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Tax-excluded prices look cheaper, but the bill can end up higher than expected.

notes:
⟦{税|ぜい}→税：03767_zei⟧ (tax) + ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧ (separate). Used as a noun and as a parenthetical price label, usually written （{税別|ぜいべつ}）.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {税別|ぜいべつ}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: pre-tax price
- {税別|ぜいべつ}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧: tax-excluded display
- {税別|ぜいべつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表示|ひょうじ}する→表示する：26973_hyoujisuru⟧: to display prices without tax

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{税込|ぜいこみ}→税込：09559_zeikomi⟧: tax included — direct opposite
- ⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: base price (before tax) — formal equivalent on receipts
- ⟦{外税|そとぜい}→外税：10262_sotozei⟧: 'external tax' — pricing convention where tax is added separately at checkout
